scope: Build 3 exact world selection. Public Test 22 source/compiled controls and synthetic packages. Timing is model-only; no Flycast, console, TA stream or linked-disc qualification.

identity.normalization: Complete translation units with -E -P; debug line records omitted consistently. Executable optimization and SH4 ABI flags are retained. Actual baseline/current Make recipes and generated headers are independently compared.

make.scope: Check real Make wiring, five-knob combinations and existing guard contracts.

host.scope:
Exact Build 3 picks, masks, ranges and accounting over synthetic R4IM data.

The actual selector and numeric helper bodies are extracted from production;
MeshPackage::adopt validates every package. Host floating point is compared
locally in each mode. This is not a target timing or gameplay/TA capture.
host.matrix_scope: All32 prior-switch definitions in the extracted shared selector, plus guard profiles; complete TU builds establish composition. Not a32-way queue integration run.
host.numerical_scope: Nonfinite helper checks are host-only. Whole poisoned Pick buffers are compared; unused tails may contain matching speculative writes.

production_size.scope: Complete native_static TU; byte counts by ELF section classes. Not a linked-disc memory gate.
production_size.stack_scope: Compiler per-function frames, not a whole-program watermark. The malformed decreasing-end fallback adds100B before the retained72B helper; target fallback execution was not qualified.

target.scope: Final frozen-source compiled selector model. Full exact comparison covers scalar/lean, full/light, cone0/1. Cost subset is public runtime SG1/light. All five previous knobs on. No rendering or TA capture. Architectural data accesses, not D-cache misses or bus bytes.

model_scope.warm: Repository SH4 hwsim; perfect I/D caches, no DMA/bus/SQ cost or final pipeline drain. A scheduling model estimate, not console/Flycast timing.
model_scope.cold: Initially empty8KB I-cache once per complete part entry/exit; perfect D-cache. Synthetic ELF placement affects misses.
model_scope.traffic: Architectural demand load/store instructions/bytes include stack and PC literals; instruction fetches excluded.32B unique-line union and sum of per-record-interval unions are separate. Neither is a cache-miss or external-bus-traffic count.
model_scope.intervals: Split at first demand read of each meshlet/cluster header; prefix entry and exit retained. Fully-inside paths can pick indices without reading meshlet headers.
model_scope.whole_frame_limit: 500 tested meshlets are an explicit synthetic assumption, not inferred from500 drawn pieces or an r101 census. No inferred D-cache-miss timing benefit.
